note: Tier 2, vendor-documented, not captured here: OpenAI Chat Completions (POST /v1/chat/completions, o3-mini) rejecting temperature on a reasoning model, as reported at https://github.com/openai/openai-python/issues/2072 and https://community.openai.com/t/o3-mini-unsupported-parameter-temperature/1140846. The body is the documented {error: {message, type, param, code}} envelope re-serialized compactly. lifted_type is the error.type routectl lifts from the body.
body: {"error":{"message":"Unsupported parameter: 'temperature' is not supported with this model.","type":"invalid_request_error","param":"temperature","code":"unsupported_parameter"}}
